ticket.title: Make the gaugeblock suite gates installable in CI
ticket.description:
CI runs the cargo gates and the no_std target build, but miter audit, miter deps and chalkline docs check cannot run there: the tools are built from local sibling checkouts under ~/dev2026/neurosymbolic-suite and are not on crates.io, so a runner has no way to obtain them. The suite-gates job exists but is disabled so the omission is visible rather than implied coverage. Close by publishing the tools or by documenting a git-based install pinned to a release tag, then flip the job on.

OUTCOME 2026-11-12 - completed on feat/af-19-suite-gates-in-ci, measured by installing the exact pinned
versions from crates.io into a clean root and running each step:

  cargo install miter-cli     --version 0.1.0-beta.4 --locked   -> installed (executable miter)
  cargo install chalkline-cli --version 0.1.0-beta.4 --locked   -> installed (executable chalkline)
  miter audit --path . --threshold 250                          -> exit 0, no files exceed 250 lines
  chalkline docs check -d .                                     -> exit 0, 9 present, 0 missing, 0 drifted

The premise was partly stale in the useful direction: both tools ARE on crates.io at 0.1.0-beta.4
(published 2026-10-14 and 2026-10-22), so the job installs from the registry instead of building
from sibling checkouts, which is what the ticket hoped for.

One gate could not join them. miter deps --unused is absent from the published miter: its
v0.1.0-beta.4 tag predates the subcommand by 87 commits. Installing miter from git at HEAD does not
work either, and that is the more interesting result, because it is structural rather than a version
lag: miter's workspace takes gaugeblock-security by relative path into the sibling common repository,
so a clone of miter alone cannot resolve its own manifests. Measured:

  cargo install --git https://github.com/gaugeblock/miter --rev 2c6f9b0 --locked miter-cli
  error: failed to load manifest for workspace member .../crates/engine
  Caused by: failed to read .../common/crates/gaugeblock-security/Cargo.toml (No such file)

The tools are self-contained only as published packages. So miter deps --unused stays a local Tier 3
gate and joins CI when a miter release carries it; the workflow comment and AGENTS.md section 7 both
name the reason, so the omission cannot read as coverage we do not have. Reported upstream to the
suite as its own ticket.
acceptance_criteria: the suite-gates job runs on every push and pull request with no if: false guard
miter audit --threshold 250 and chalkline docs check -d . execute against crates.io-pinned tool versions and pass
the absent miter deps gate is explained in the workflow and in AGENTS.md section 7, so its absence cannot read as coverage
AGENTS.md section 7 no longer records the CI gap as open for the gates that now run

diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index 95a6bd6..605d244 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -78,15 +78,42 @@ jobs:
       - run: cargo check -p aerofoil-common --target thumbv7em-none-eabi
 
   suite-gates:
-    # miter (file-length ceiling, dependency hygiene) and chalkline (nine-document audit) are built
-    # from this workspace's sibling repositories today and are not installable from a registry, so
-    # they cannot run here yet. Left as a visibly disabled job instead of an omitted gate: a silent
-    # omission would read as coverage we do not have. Flip to `if: true` once every tool installs.
+    # The gates that cargo alone cannot express: miter's file-length ceiling and chalkline's
+    # nine-document audit. Both are installed from crates.io at the exact versions this repository's
+    # gates were verified against (2026-11-12) rather than tracking latest — an unpinned gate
+    # silently redefines what "green" means here every time a tool releases.
+    #
+    # `miter deps --unused` is deliberately absent rather than quietly failing: `miter-cli
+    # 0.1.0-beta.4` on crates.io predates that subcommand by 87 commits, and installing from git
+    # does not work either — miter's workspace takes `gaugeblock-security` by relative path into the
+    # sibling `common` repository, so a clone of miter alone fails to resolve its manifests
+    # (measured: `failed to read .../common/crates/gaugeblock-security/Cargo.toml`). Until a miter
+    # release carries the command it stays a local Tier 3 gate. See AGENTS.md §7.
     name: Suite gates (miter, chalkline)
-    if: false
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    env:
+      MITER_VERSION: 0.1.0-beta.4
+      CHALKLINE_VERSION: 0.1.0-beta.4
     steps:
-      - run: |
-          echo "Blocked: gaugeblock suite tools are not distributable yet."
-          echo "See AGENTS.md §7 for the recorded gap."
-          exit 1
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
+        with:
+          toolchain: "1.99"
+
+      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
+
+      # `--locked` so each tool's published lockfile decides its own dependencies — without it a
+      # transitive release can break a gate on a commit that changed nothing but the calendar.
+      - name: Install the suite gates
+        run: |
+          cargo install miter-cli --version "$MITER_VERSION" --locked
+          cargo install chalkline-cli --version "$CHALKLINE_VERSION" --locked
+
+      # Hard ceiling: a file at 250 lines cannot land (AGENTS.md §3.2). The 200-line sweep stays a
+      # local advisory, because it is evidence for planning a split rather than a verdict.
+      - name: miter audit (250-line ceiling)
+        run: miter audit --path . --threshold 250
+
+      - name: chalkline docs check (nine-document audit)
+        run: chalkline docs check -d .

-   tracked as `AF-19`. Do not delete the disabled job to make the pipeline look complete.
+1. **Two of the three suite gates now run in CI** (closed as `AF-19`). `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
+   enforces format, clippy, nextest, doc tests, a release build, the MSRV build, the `no_std` target,
+   and — new — `miter audit --threshold 250` and `chalkline docs check`, installing `miter-cli` and
+   `chalkline-cli` from crates.io pinned in the job's `env` block. The earlier claim that they were
+   not installable at all stopped being true once they were published. `miter deps --unused` is the
+   exception and stays a local Tier 3 gate: the published miter predates the subcommand by 87
+   commits, and a git install cannot stand in, because miter's workspace takes `gaugeblock-security`
+   by relative path into the sibling `common` repository. It joins CI when a miter release carries
+   the command. Keep the pin current: bumping it changes what green means, so it is a reviewed
+   change, never routine maintenance. Do not weaken the job to make the pipeline look green.
 2. **`no_std` is proven in CI, not locally.** `aerofoil-common` is `#![no_std]` and keeps the
    attribute unconditional by putting its tests in `tests/`; the `no_std` CI job compiles it for
    `thumbv7em-none-eabi` and passed on the first push to `main`. No such target is installed on the
diff --git a/CHANGELOG.md b/CHANGELOG.md
index 534dbf1..95fcdaa 100644
--- a/CHANGELOG.md
+++ b/CHANGELOG.md
@@ -58,10 +58,9 @@ crates, in the imperative, one line each, with the `storypole` task key in paren
 
 ### Changed
 
+- Run the gaugeblock suite gates in CI, installing `miter-cli` and `chalkline-cli` from crates.io at pinned versions and enforcing `miter audit --threshold 250` and `chalkline docs check` on every push (`AF-19`).
 - Declare a reserved `default` verification chain so a ticket scoped to neither a crate nor a repository executes the configured gate instead of the `cargo test` fallback (`AF-99`).
-
 - Migrate the `.gaugeblock/storypole` store from a single append-only `ledger.jsonl` to one record per ticket under `tickets/<KEY>.json`, and archive the superseded ledger to `ledger-archive/` as read-only history (`AF-99`).
-
 - Skip redundant 2D terrain-draped vector line layers in 3D when volumetric airspace layers mount (`MapLibreVectorManager`), reuse GeoJSON sources via `setData`, throttle `AntennaCoverageLayer` contour redraws to 2s with a 0.25nm jitter filter, and serve compressible HTTP static assets with gzip content negotiation in `aerofoil-server` (`AF-97`).
 - Coalesce server WebSocket target broadcasts into single JSON array frames (`ws.rs`), batch frontend target ingestion per animation frame, switch `TelemetryTableRenderer` to keyed `<tr>` DOM updates (`500ms`), and patch `AircraftInspector` fields in place (`AF-96`).
 - Render 3D aircraft models using WebGL2 instanced VAOs (`drawElementsInstanced`, <= 5 draw calls/frame), cache DEM terrain elevation queries by spatial cell (`MapLibreTerrainElevCache`), and dirty-flag 3D line VBO uploads (`AF-94`).
